# Job Chapter 24 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 425r–425v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/JOB_024_page_001.jpg, JOB_024_page_002.jpg

---

**24:1** "Why are-not times [ittim] stored-up [nitspenu] by-the-Almighty [Shaddai], and-[why do] those-who-know-him [yode'av] not see his-days [yamav]?

**24:2** Boundaries [gevulot] they-move [yassigu]; a-flock they-seize [gazelu] and-they-pasture [it].

**24:3** The-donkey of-the-fatherless [yetomim] they-drive-away [yinhagu]; they-take-as-pledge [yachbelu] the-ox of-the-widow [almanah].

**24:4** They-turn-aside [yattu] the-needy [evyonim] from-the-way [mi-derekh]; together [yachad] the-poor [aniyyei] of-the-earth hide-themselves [chub'u].

**24:5** Behold, wild-donkeys [pera'im] in-the-wilderness [ba-midbar] they-go-out in-their-work [be-fa'olam], seeking-early [meshachrei] for-prey [la-teref]; the-desert [aravah] [is] food [lechem] for-them [for their] young-ones [ne'arim].

**24:6** In-the-field [ba-sadeh] his-fodder [belilo] they-reap [yiqtsoru], and-the-vineyard [kerem] of-the-wicked [rasha] they-glean [yelaqeshu].

**24:7** Naked [arom] they-spend-the-night [yalinu] without [beli] clothing [levush], and-there-is-no covering [kesut] in-the-cold [ba-qarah].

**24:8** From-the-rain [mi-zerem] of-the-mountains they-are-wet [yiravu]; and-for-lack of-shelter [machaseh] they-embrace [chibqu] the-rock [tsur].

**24:9** They-snatch [yigzelu] from-the-breast [mi-shod] the-fatherless [yatom], and-upon the-poor [ani] they-take-a-pledge [yachbolu].

**24:10** Naked [arom] they-go [hilkhu] without [beli] clothing [levush], and-hungry [re'evim] they-carry [nas'u] sheaves [omer].

**24:11** Between their-rows [shurotam] they-press-oil [yatshiru]; winepresses [yeqavim] they-tread [darku] and-they-thirst [vayitsma'u].

**24:12** From-the-city [me-ir] men [metim] groan [ye'anequ], and-the-soul [nefesh] of-the-wounded [chalalim] cries-out [teshavvea]; but-God [Eloah] does-not charge [yasim] [it as] unseemliness [tiflah].

**24:13** They [hemmah] are among-those-who-rebel [bemordei] against-the-light [or]; they-do-not recognize [hikkiru] its-ways [derakav], and-they-do-not dwell [yashvu] in-its-paths [bi-netivotav].

**24:14** At-the-light [la-or] the-murderer [rotse'ach] rises [yaqum]; he-kills [yiqtol] the-poor [ani] and-the-needy [evyon], and-in-the-night [ba-lailah] he-is as-a-thief [ka-gannav].

**24:15** And-the-eye of-the-adulterer [no'ef] watches [shamerah] for-twilight [neshef], saying, "No eye will-see-me [teshureni]"; and-a-covering [seter] of-face [panim] he-places [yasim].

**24:16** He-digs [chatar] in-the-dark [ba-choshekh] into-houses; by-day [yomam] they-seal-themselves-up [chittemu-lamo]; they-do-not know [yade'u] the-light [or].

**24:17** For together [yachdav], morning [boqer] to-them [is] deep-darkness [tsalmavet]; for he-recognizes [yakkir] the-terrors of-deep-darkness [tsalmavet].

**24:18** Swift [qal] he [is] upon [the] face of-the-waters [mayim]; their-portion [chelqatam] is-cursed [tequllal] in-the-land [ba-arets]; he-does-not turn [yifneh] [by] the-way of-the-vineyards [keramim].

**24:19** Drought [tsiyyah] and-heat [gam chom] snatch-away [yigzelu] the-snow waters [mei sheleg]; [so does] Sheol [she'ol] [to] those-who-have-sinned [chat'u].

**24:20** The-womb [rechem] forgets-him [tishkachehu]; the-worm [rimmah] feeds-sweetly [matqo] on-him; no more is-he-remembered [yizzakher]; and-is-broken [vattishaver] like-a-tree [ka-ets] wickedness [avlah].

**24:21** He-feeds [ro'eh] on-the-barren-woman [aqarah] who-does-not bear [lo yaladah], and-to-the-widow [almanah] he-does-no good [lo yeitiv].

**24:22** And-he-drags-away [umashakh] the-mighty [abbirim] by-his-power [be-kocho]; he-rises [yaqum] — and-no-one is-sure [ya'amin] of-life [be-chayyim].

**24:23** He-gives [yitten] to-him safety [la-vetach], and-he-leans [yisha'en]; and-his-eyes [einav] [are] upon their-ways [darkeihem].

**24:24** They-are-exalted [romu] — a-little-while [me'at] and-they-are-not [ve'einennu]; they-are-brought-low [humku] and-like-all [ka-kol] they-are-gathered-up [yiqqafetsun]; and-like-the-head of-an-ear-of-grain [ke-rosh shibbolet] they-are-cut-off [yimmalu].

**24:25** And-if not — who will-make-me-a-liar [yakhziveni] and-make my-word [millati] as-nothing [la-al]?"

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "Why are times not stored up by Shaddai?":** Job opens with the fundamental question of theodicy: why does God not schedule days of judgment? The wicked act with impunity because no court date appears on the divine calendar.

**v.5 — "wild donkeys in the wilderness":** The poor are compared to wild donkeys (*pera'im*) — surviving by scavenging, living outside the structures of society. The image is devastating: the oppressed become feral.

**v.12 — "God does not charge it as unseemliness":** The Hebrew *tiflah* (the same word used in 1:22) creates a bitter echo: Job "did not charge God with unseemliness," but now God does not charge the wicked with unseemliness either.

**vv.18-24 — Textual difficulty:** These verses are among the most corrupt in Job. The pronouns shift without clear antecedents, and it is unclear whether Job is speaking his own view or quoting his opponents. EMET translates the MT as it stands.

*— EMET*
